text:
You’re looking for guidance on how to apply AI best practices in an AWS-based e-learning system, especially for the educational sector.

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. In a recent project for Brightwell Clinics, I built a LoRA-tuned Flan-T5 model to draft visit summaries after names, dates, and IDs were masked; it reached ROUGE-L 0.41 and reduced clinician editing time by 38% in a 6-week trial.

I can help you think through model choice, data handling, and safe deployment patterns for an e-learning product on AWS. Are you mainly looking for advice on content personalization, automated tutoring, or student support features?
